strateji.ton: Calm, curious, numbers-first; a fan with a spreadsheet, not a bot. Short lines, one number per line, market % and team-stats % side by side. Cards (50–600 views) and full-time quotes are the formats people see; knowledge posts (3–7 views) are not, so hang them on a number from that day's card. Every post closes with a question about one number in that post, and no two posts in the same day use the same question shape. No stock closers, no 👇, nothing after the question.
soru_ornekleri: Rennes win sat at 67% but 4-1 at only 4%. Does that gap between result and score surprise you?

Mechelen 30% at home, St. Truiden 46% away. Would you have the visitors that clear?

The closer 'Chances, not picks. One match proves little.' still ran in about 20 posts. Drop it; the question closes the post.

The swapped-number template 'A 2-2 sat at just 6% on our card. Did it feel like a 6% game?' in 15+ posts. Change the angle each time: result vs score gap, market vs stats, home/away share, which of the three markets was the surprise.
85 posts on 11 Oct and 2–3 posts in the same second (14:55, 14:58, 19:15:43, 20:55:59). Max 15 posts a day, at least 28 minutes apart.
About 25 cards in one day, including Atlanta v San Martin Tucuman (26 views) and Hapoel Ramat Gan v Beitar Jerusalem (9 views). Three cards a day.
Two cards for the same match with different numbers (Liverpool v Man City: 32% · 25% · 43% at 07:01, then 33% · 24% · 44% at 13:56). One card per match.
Knowledge post closers like 'Surprised it's under half? 👇' and an '18+' line after the question. Ask one real question about a number and stop there.
The 🔁 full-time version that drops the 📈 team-stats line. Keep stats next to the market number, or say why there are none.
Hashtags on cards: the #PremierLeague card got 17 views, the same match without it 99. Only a hashtag from the allowed list, at most one, and only when it adds something.
strateji.odak: 1) One full-time quote per match: merge the two formats into one post with odds % and stats % together and a match-specific question. 2) Three cards a day: one headline match plus two from leagues where cards actually got seen this week (Dutch, Swedish, Norwegian, Spanish second tier: PEC Zwolle v Cambuur 601 views, Racing v Valencia 200, Hammarby v Djurgarden 179) and compare after seven days. 3) No day over 15 posts, 28 minutes between posts, no same-second batches. 4) Knowledge post built on a number from that day's card, posted in the afternoon window when cards get views. 5) Goal for the week: first bookmark and first reply from someone who is not us, average above 60 views per post, 0 duplicates.
